content: Yook ambo bi ye karub yeman. Nongbed wangki yemaniib. Maskil ye yook Dewidbed wongkoon. Sifdanbed Sauliib yaa wene yedmiwen, “Dewid kuu nuwokad aom aomne biknoon.” andiwen kumbed wongkoon.

content.text: O God, ewaningko yaromkono yaambed ne nen burudande angka kowe.
Eb aromkonombed ne dowad ebbed wengyundeneb ma ambarakmindo ande.
O God, ne kurikuri weng kee wengambere.
Ne mongkodkono aombed ne weng kee wengambere.
Amborom kuu noroddanbed ne yaa nandamiib,
kwane yeremboromdanbed ne nenbande kowi kiwaan onmiib,
yi kuu God yaa meenimokban kui.Selah
Kedi, God kuu ne awawi ye karub,
Yariman kuu ne awawaane yiminmo dobirimain ye karub.
Ne yaa yemyeb darobidanbed ne yaa arewa kamenabi kuu yembed amonombe yi yaa kerundok.
God, eb korondiyiibban eweng awinimo dobiri ye kerekmen yaambed yi ben monmarunde.
O Yariman, eb yaa nindorokiibbed munob koni yeman kabdaniin.
amborom kuu eb kuu amunmo kowe.
Kedi, dabab ne yaa meneboon korem kuu yembed ne nen burudande angka kowoon,
kwane wedmaane yembed ne bondan ari boknoon.
